analysis_md: 若基向量按行排列，则 $T_1(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)A$，$T_2(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)B$。故 $(2T_1+3T_2)(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)(2A+3B)$，所求矩阵为 $2A+3B$。
